about_the_game:
Enter DRAGONFLY, a fast-paced tactical FPS with a dynamic game world and aggressive enemies that use the environment to their advantage. Waking up in the harness of a stolen cybernetic fighting harness and hunted by bloodthirsty mercs on the payroll of your former boss, you must shoot your way through the cragged skeleton of a city fading into nothingness, where warring factions rip each other to gory shreds over the scraps of a decaying world. Aided by an eccentric group of remnants, your only hope is to discover why you’re being hunted- and kill the one responsible.

  • Progress through a number of varied environments, ranging from barren war-torn ruins to opulent futuristic compounds.

  • Each mission gives you multiple avenues of approach to outflank your enemies, and has secret areas and items to reward your curiosity.

  • Environments that are filled to the brim with destructible structures and interactive mechanisms that you can exploit to outmatch your enemies- and if you're not careful, they can use to outsmart you.

  • Wield a wide arsenal of hard-hitting weaponry, ranging from obsolescent but beefy pre-war revolvers and standard police shotguns to advanced high-tech laser emitters and gigantic anti-tank rifles.

  • Fit out your fighting harness with various upgrades, giving you the ability to smash straight through concrete walls, see behind solid cover, and dodge bullets.

  • Fight clever enemies who'll try to flank and surprise you.

  • Cavort through a dying realm where your actions (or inaction) affects those around you.

  • And more? And more.

content_descriptors.notes: Contains stylized depictions of violence, drug use, warfare, and strong profanity.

short_description: Kill your former boss, explore a fading world, interact with an assorted cast of potential friends (and some real enemies), and control a possibly-sentient armored cybernetic exoskeleton while armed ruffians try to give you high-velocity lead poisoning.
